theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_un_smooth_glue
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → F), (∀ y ∈ M, ∃ (O : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → F), IsOpen O ∧ y ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g O ∧ ∀ z ∈ M ∩ O, g z = f z) → ∃ (ν : Euclid P → F) (O : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, ν x = f x
